name: Idaho Milk Products
old_description: Our brand new ice cream facility is open! We are excited to bring this business to our home right here in the Magic Valley. Our mission remains the same, we are daring food to be better. Come and see how we are innovating the ice cream industry.
about:
Idaho Milk Products operates from Jerome, Idaho, in the heart of the Magic Valley. The company recently commissioned a new ice cream and blending facility, expanding its existing dairy ingredient operations. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

The company produces a range of dairy ingredients including milk protein, milk permeate, and cream, and runs a dedicated ice cream manufacturing line. Its Milk Innovation Center houses food scientists who collaborate directly with customer R&D teams to develop formulations from concept to commercial scale. The plant runs at up to 16,000 lbs per hour with flexible batch sizing, and uses a Russel Finnex Compact 1200 sifter for post-mixing purity. Analytical testing, bagging, and real-world trial capabilities support the production process.

Primary customers are food and beverage manufacturers in the dairy sector, including brands seeking high-protein ingredients and custom ice cream formulations. The company also serves industrial and energy sectors through its E&I designation, though its core focus remains dairy innovation.

Idaho Milk Products emphasizes an integrated farm-to-bag supply chain for traceability and freshness, a sustainability commitment rooted in responsible stewardship, and a mission to “dare food to be better” through scientific innovation and customer partnership.
